newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer Services head exchanges shares.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer Services head exchanges shares.

text.p: Biotech company Pioneer Services International Ltd said Monday its president has agreed to exchange 45 million shares of the company's common stock for 45,000 shares of convertible preferred stock.
As a result of the agreement, the company's shares outstanding have been reduced by 62 percent from about 72.2 million to about 27.2 million.
Each share is convertible into 1,000 common shares, it added.
